about: movebench14: what tools/movebench/acts_test.py puts on six monster attacks before it plays them, over the file's own live spec (a section named here replaces that section). These are test settings, never written to data/moves/ and never played by the game: Tom sets his own on the workbench page. golden_acts.json is what the engine plays with them.

act:mudling:mud_pie.why: a charged, thrown attack (wind-up first): a freeze, a shake and a splash on the family member it hits

act:toad:body_slam.why: a melee attack: two effects (one at the hit, one a quarter second after, on each target), a sound on an effect

act:log:timber.why: a staged attack: five stage steps around a named hit moment, with a freeze, a shake and an effect on top

act:skeeter:darting_bite.why: a melee attack with badges on the target and nothing else

act:grump:bog_splash.why: a thrown attack with no video of its own (it plays the default throw): a library projectile instead of the default ball, a splash and a freeze

act:bigone:crown_polish.why: a buff on itself with no hit: effects on the monster itself (self) and on its allies
